interval_take: Three structural stories this week. First: Bhooth Bangla's 23% Wednesday drop (₹8 Cr Tue → ₹6.85 Cr Wed BCM) is sharper than the W1 horror-comedy template. Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2 held flat into 1st Wed; Stree 2 jumped. BB's softer hold signals a HIT (₹160 Cr lifetime trajectory) not a SUPER HIT. Second weekend will decide the verdict ceiling. Second: D2 entering deep weekday rhythm at ₹1.70 Cr/day is a textbook All-Time Blockbuster decay (λ ≈ 0.55) — exactly what BCM modelled. The Pathaan UK overtake is the milestone story this week. Third: Vaazha 2 has quietly become 2026's most over-performing film at ₹113 Cr India nett against a sub-₹15 Cr budget. Trade press has been under-reporting the lifetime by ₹10+ Cr — Boxoffy correction issued.

headline: D2 Crosses ₹920 Cr on D14. Bhooth Bangla Blinks. ₹1,000 Cr India This Week.
subline: D14 ₹20.10 Cr (Wed Apr 1) confirmed by Sacnilk. D0–D14 ₹920.02 Cr India nett. Bhooth Bangla moved to Apr 17 giving D2 a clear W3 window. ₹1,000 Cr India nett — first ever for a Hindi film — is the conversation this week. Super Mario Galaxy opens globally. IPL underway.

scoreboard.note: D14 ₹20.10 Cr ✅ (Sacnilk) · D0–D14 ₹920.02 Cr · WW ~₹1,466 Cr · D15 Hanuman Jayanti est ₹10 Cr · Bhooth Bangla cleared field → clean W3
W2 India ~₹4.5 Cr est · US $164.3M cume · WW $300M+ · Super Mario Galaxy opens this weekend — PHM shifts to #2

interval_take: ₹920 Cr in 14 days. Bhooth Bangla — which had already moved once — moved again, citing D2's run. That is the truest indicator of a cultural phenomenon. When competing films rearrange their own release calendars around you, the box office has spoken. ₹1,000 Cr India nett would be the first time a Hindi film has crossed that number. Baahubali 2 did it, Pushpa 2 did it — both Telugu. Dhurandhar 2 is two weekends away from making history in Hindi cinema's own language.

D0–D12 India nett stands at ₹867 Cr on BOI basis (Sacnilk calculates ₹872 Cr using D5 ₹65 Cr — Boxoffy takes BOI's ₹60 Cr). KGF Chapter 2's India lifetime (₹859.7 Cr nett) has been passed. ₹1,000 Cr nett is the next milestone — at D8-D12 averaging ₹49.5 Cr/day, the film needs 3–4 more strong days. WW stands at ~₹1,392 Cr. NA has already broken Baahubali 2's all-time Indian film record at $23M+. D2 is now the #2 Hindi film of all time in India nett behind Pathaan (₹543 Cr? No) — actually #1 Hindi film of all time.
nextWeek: D13 Tue + D14 Wed key — ₹1,000 Cr India nett target by Thu Apr 2. IPL headwind manageable on weekdays. D2 eyes Pathaan overseas record. No new major Hindi competition until mid-April.
